en: No, it was my pleasure.{wait}{clear}
Angel, I trust you understand that...{wait}{clear}
Yes, this stays a secret from everyone, right?{wait}{clear}
Yes. I'm counting on you.{wait}{clear}
Um, Florinda said she'd made a new costume and wanted me to see it... She should be somewhere around here...{wait}{clear}
Oh! Angel, you came!{wait}{clear}
Florinda, are you here? Where are you?{wait}{clear}
Over heeere! Here, here!{wait}{clear}
Where, Florinda? All I can see are squirrels...{wait}{clear}
Hehehe, Angel, I'm right here, here!{wait}{clear}
Ah, Florinda. So that's where you were.{wait}{clear}
Angel, this costume's suuuper well made, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}
You couldn't even tell where Florin was!{wait}{clear}
Yes, it really is. It's well made, and it suits you very well.{wait}{clear}
Ahah! The Angel praised me!{wait}{clear}
Well, shall we head back soon, Florinda?{wait}{clear}
Okaaay!{wait}{clear}
Florin was super happy you praised her, Angel!{wait}{clear}
But you've already changed out of it?{wait}{clear}
Yep. That one's a costume for playing with everyone, not for work.{wait}{clear}
Is that so?{wait}{clear}
Yep. You change costumes to suit what you're doing!{wait}{clear}
But you've already gone and changed out of it?{wait}{clear}
Yep. That one's the costume for playing with everyone.{wait}{clear}
You change to suit what you're doing, right?{wait}{clear}
Yep, that's Florin's policy!{wait}{clear}
Another day passing by... But there's still so much to do. I need to stay focused.{wait}{clear}
Haah...{wait}{clear}
Phew...{wait}{clear}
That sounds like Shelly. I wonder what's wrong...?{wait}{clear}
Um... Shelly?{wait}{clear}
Oh, Angel...{wait}{clear}
You seem down. Did something happen?{wait}{clear}
N-no... It's nothing.{wait}{clear}
This isn't like you at all, Shelly. If you don't mind talking to me, won't you tell me?{wait}{clear}
Sorry, Angel. It's just... I got a little sad...{wait}{clear}
Sad?{wait}{clear}
I was so happy to have a day off that I flew all over the place, but everywhere I went there was fighting and stuff...{wait}{clear}
And seeing that, it felt like me playing around was something I shouldn't be doing...{wait}{clear}
What are you saying, Shelly? You haven't done anything wrong at all.{wait}{clear}
But, Angel...{wait}{clear}
You work hard, so you need a day off now and then.{wait}{clear}
You think so...? But thank you. Talking to you has made me feel a little better.{wait}{clear}
Really? Then I'm glad. Well, shall we head back? It'll be getting dark soon.{wait}{clear}
Are you feeling a little better?{wait}{clear}
Yes, Angel. Thank you for today.{wait}{clear}
Thinking about all kinds of things is good, but I'd like you to stay the cheerful Shelly you always are.{wait}{clear}
Hehe, you're right! Starting tomorrow, I'll do my best and be cheerful again!{wait}{clear}
Thinking about all kinds of things is good, but please stay the Shelly who messes up cheerfully and then reflects on it from the bottom of her heart.{wait}{clear}
Aww, Angel, that's kinda mean! But you're right! Starting tomorrow, I'll do my best and be cheerful!{wait}{clear}
The air is so crisp tonight... And what a lovely moon...{wait}{clear}
Fufufu...{wait}{clear}
Mmm, this feels nice...{wait}{clear}
That sounds like Lily... Let's go take a look...{wait}{clear}
Lily... is that you?{wait}{clear}
Oh, Angel? What's the matter? At this hour of the night?{wait}{clear}
Nothing, I just heard your voice... But what are you doing out here?{wait}{clear}
Fufu... The moon was so beautiful, I felt like playing a little.{wait}{clear}
And this snow... So pure white and powdery...{wait}{clear}
Isn't it just magical? So I somehow felt like romping around.{wait}{clear}
It really is lovely... tonight.{wait}{clear}
Yes. I'd never want to spoil a view this beautiful...{wait}{clear}
Lily...{wait}{clear}
Haah, that was fun... But, Angel, aren't you cold?{wait}{clear}
What about you, Lily? Aren't you cold dressed like that?{wait}{clear}
No, I'm fine. I suppose neither we nor you are at the mercy of the weather.{wait}{clear}
That's true. We can hardly say we can't work because it's too cold or too hot.{wait}{clear}
Fufufu... That's right.{wait}{clear}
Still, I always assumed that on your days off, Lily, you'd just be lazing around.{wait}{clear}
How rude, Angel. I'm not sleeping all the time, you know.{wait}{clear}
There are all kinds of ways to take it easy!{wait}{clear}
I gave Lynx a day off... but I worry whether he's actually resting. He tends to overdo things...{wait}{clear}
Ah! Angel! Look out!{wait}{clear}
Ow, ow...{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry! Angel, are you all right?{wait}{clear}
Angel, hang in there...!{wait}{clear}
Ah, Lynx... What on earth were you doing?{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry, Angel. I wanted to be even a little useful to the heroes, so I was practicing fighting.{wait}{clear}
Lynx... I understand how you feel, but here in the world below, fairies can't use their power to fight.{wait}{clear}
I know...{wait}{clear}
But, but... I... I... I just really want to try fighting as cool as the heroes do!{wait}{clear}
I see... You're very brave and very kind, Lynx.{wait}{clear}
Huh? Angel?!{wait}{clear}
Now, shall we head back? We can't lie around like this forever.{wait}{clear}
Y-yes!{wait}{clear}
I'm really sorry, Angel. Does it hurt?{wait}{clear}
No, I'm fine.{wait}{clear}But although I understand how you feel, you mustn't do anything dangerous from now on. All right?{wait}{clear}
Okay! From now on, I'll only practice where nobody ever comes!{wait}{clear}
Um... That's not quite what I meant...{wait}{clear}
Now, I've given Aquila a day off too... I hope she's taking it easy.{wait}{clear}
Eek! Ahahaha!{wait}{clear}
Aquila?{wait}{clear}
Ahaha, that tickles!{wait}{clear}
Ahaha!{wait}{clear}
Oh, Angel...!{wait}{clear}
You look like you're having fun, Aquila.{wait}{clear}
Um... Playing with everyone like this really does clear my head...{wait}{clear}
I see. I'm glad to hear it.{wait}{clear}
Yes. Every so often you need to play to your heart's content like this, don't you?{wait}{clear}
That's right. A change of pace is important.{wait}{clear}
Yes, I think so too.{wait}{clear}
Um, but since you've come for me, Angel, I'll head back now.{wait}{clear}
Then shall we go back together?{wait}{clear}
Yes, Angel.{wait}{clear}
Have you shaken off your fatigue, Aquila?{wait}{clear}
Yes, thank you, Angel. Um... When I get tired, I can't do my job...{wait}{clear}
But I shouldn't keep asking for days off all the time, should I...?{wait}{clear}
Well... Taking too many days off would be...{wait}{clear}
Oh, oh, of course. I'm sorry, Angel. I'll be fine. I'll do my best again.{wait}{clear}
Thank you, Aquila. But don't push yourself too hard, all right?{wait}{clear}
Cetus's day off should be about over by now...{wait}{clear}
Delicious!{wait}{clear}
Is that you over there, Cetus...?{wait}{clear}
Oh, Angel! Yep, it's me.{wait}{clear}
Mornin', Angel. Great weather again today, huh?{wait}{clear}
Yes... I suppose...{wait}{clear}
Oh, want some tea too, Angel? It's good stuff.{wait}{clear}
N-no, I'm fine, thank you. But, Cetus...{wait}{clear}
Yeah? Something wrong?{wait}{clear}
No, it's just... You don't look or talk like the usual Cetus...{wait}{clear}
Hahaha! You mean this getup? This is the everyday me.{wait}{clear}
And the way I talk, I just figured it'd be bad on the job, so I keep it polite then.{wait}{clear}
Angel, my day off's not over yet, right?{wait}{clear}
Then let me have one more cup of tea. After that, I'll get back to work.{wait}{clear}
Y-yes... All right. Go ahead.{wait}{clear}
See ya later, then, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}
My apologies for earlier, Angel. I will return to work at once.{wait}{clear}
No, there's no need to rush. But, Cetus, what a difference...{wait}{clear}
Is it? It's perfectly natural to me, but perhaps it surprised you, Angel.{wait}{clear}
Keeping work and private life separate makes things easier for me. It gives my life some structure.{wait}{clear}
Well, I suppose everyone is different.{wait}{clear}
Hahaha. Yes, please think of it that way. Now, I will return to work at once.{wait}{clear}
Ah, yes, of course. I'm counting on you again, Cetus.{wait}{clear}
Lepus said there was something he wanted to show me, somewhere around here, I think...{wait}{clear}
Ah! Angel!{wait}{clear}
Ah, Lepus, good, there you are. What is it you wanted to show me?{wait}{clear}
Shh! Angel, please be quiet! Wait just a little longer.{wait}{clear}
Wow, this is amazing.{wait}{clear}
This is what I wanted to show you, Angel. What do you think?{wait}{clear}
Yes, it's truly beautiful. Wonderful. Thank you, Lepus.{wait}{clear}
